systems.name: Body & structure
systems.description: A boxy mini-SUV body: short nose, upright tail and black cladding around the wheel arches and bumpers. At under 3.2 m long, the VF 3 slips through traffic and into tight parking spots.
systems.principle: The structure carries loads around the cabin. The overhangs are very short because there is no combustion engine: the motor sits on the rear axle and the battery under the floor, so almost the whole length goes to the passengers.

systems.name: Glass & lamps
systems.description: An upright windshield, large side windows and the lamp lenses. The upright glass lets the driver judge the short nose when manoeuvring in town.
systems.principle: The windshield and side glass give visibility around the car; in the source model they are built from a solid black material, so they look darker than real glass. The lenses at the front cover the headlamps’ projectors and reflectors.

systems.name: Doors
systems.description: The VF 3 has just two long side doors; rear passengers climb in by tipping the front seatback forward. At the back, a lift-up tailgate opens onto the luggage space.
systems.principle: Each door is an assembly of outer skin, glass, latch, seals and interior trim. The two-door layout keeps the body stiff and the part count low, at the cost of easier rear-seat access.

systems.name: Passenger cabin
systems.tag: FOUR SEATS ON A FLAT FLOOR
systems.description: A four-seat cabin sitting on top of the battery. The minimal dashboard is built around a single 10-inch central touchscreen that handles both driving information and infotainment.
systems.principle: The EV’s flat floor lets two rows of seats fit inside a very short body. The source model has no detailed interior; the author placed a dark block inside to hide the void, so this section is for reference only.

systems.name: LFP battery
systems.description: A lithium iron phosphate (LFP) pack lies flat under the floor between the axles. It is good for about 210 km per charge, well matched to daily city driving.
systems.principle: LFP chemistry tolerates many charge cycles and is more thermally stable than NMC, at the cost of lower energy density. Mounting the pack low lowers the centre of gravity, steadying this tall, narrow car in corners.

systems.name: Rear motor
systems.description: A single electric motor on the rear axle drives the rear wheels. Torque is available from standstill, so the car pulls away briskly when the light turns green.
systems.principle: The inverter turns the battery’s direct current into alternating current for the motor; a single-speed reduction gear sends the rotation to both half-shafts. Lifting off or braking turns the motor into a generator that feeds energy back to the battery.

systems.name: Suspension
systems.description: A spring and damper at each wheel carry the body and settle it over potholes and speed bumps. The 191 mm ground clearance makes kerbs and shallow flooding easier to handle.
systems.principle: Springs carry the car’s weight while dampers turn oscillation energy into heat. For a short, light car like the VF 3, the tuning trades ride comfort against body control.

systems.name: Wheels & brakes
systems.description: 16-inch wheels with tall-sidewall tyres soften rough roads and help lift the ride height. Discs brake the front wheels, drums the rear.
systems.principle: Most braking force goes to the front axle, so that is where the discs are; rear drums are adequate for a light car and cheaper. The motor’s regenerative braking does part of the everyday slowing down.

pieces.interior.block: The source model has no interior; the author placed a dark block inside the body to hide the void when looking through the windows. The real VF 3 has four seats and a 10-inch central screen.
pieces.windshield: A near-vertical windshield, typical of the boxy mini-SUV shape. In the source model it is built from a solid black material.
pieces.glass.side: Side window glass. In the source model it is built from a solid black material.
pieces.door: One of the VF 3’s long side doors. With only two doors, each is made long enough for rear passengers to get in once the front seatback is tipped forward.
pieces.tailgate: The lift-up tailgate, carrying the tail lamps and the VinFast badge.
pieces.disc: Front brake disc. The VF 3 has discs on the front axle and drums on the rear.

notes: VF 3 figures are compiled from VinFast and press sources; published motor power varies between sources (30–32 kW). The 3D model is a community-built VF 3 Plus 2026, not manufacturer data.
